patronOf.en-US: Co-foundress of the Little Sisters of the Holy Family
patronOf.pt-BR: Cofundadora das Pequenas Irmãs da Sagrada Família

prayerExcerpt.en-US: "With the help of the Holy Family, I will be all things to all."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Com a ajuda da Sagrada Família, serei toda para todos."

meta.face: A countrywoman of the Lake Garda shore of about sixty with a warm, lightly sun-browned complexion and a PEAR-SHAPED face — narrower at the brow and BROAD and full at the cheeks and jaw, a straight, fairly long nose with a broad, rounded tip, SMALL eyes NARROWED by a smile, with fine crinkles at their corners, under thin, slightly RAISED, arched brows, a WIDE mouth in a warm, closed smile, a broad, rounded chin; the gaze toward us, motherly and a little amused.
meta.basis: Her photograph (before 1934, on the Dicastery's page and Wikimedia Commons): a broad, full lower face under a narrower brow, small smiling eyes, raised brows, a straight nose with a broad tip and a wide mouth, in the black veil and the wide white collar. The card keeps her at about sixty, as there.
meta.excerpt: Her written resolution «Con l'aiuto della Sacra Famiglia sarò tutta a tutti», which she often wrote among her resolutions, as quoted by Città Nuova (2022); the Dicastery's biography also says she made herself «tutta a tutti»; our rendering (she died in 1934)
